presentation.label: LOOP SYNC
presentation.summary: Keeps sample loops in time with the project tempo by repitching them; AUTO reads each loop's tempo from its length, locks and scenes included.
presentation.overview: In AUTO the mod works out each loop's source tempo from the length of the sample that plays (between STA and END, 4/4, cut on the bar) and adds the matching pitch shift to the track's effective TUN every audio block, after parameter locks, scenes and the LFO. A SMP lock or a scene that changes the sample is followed, each sample by its own length. A percentage correction (FUNC + FIN) on top of any mode puts loops with a tail or a gap back in time. Pitch follows tempo; no time-stretch.
highlights: AUTO: no tempo to enter for loops cut on the bar.
SMP locks and scenes stay in time, each sample from its own length.
TUN stays yours: the shift is added on top, so a TUN lock still transposes.
Trailing silence is left out automatically, and each sample keeps its own correction.
usage: Load a loop cut on the bar, for example one bar at 120 BPM, on a sound track with a trig on step 1.
Press SMPL, hold FUNC and turn TUN to AUTO: the box reads AUTO over 1BAR 120.0, and SYNC appears at the bottom right.
Play and change the tempo: the loop follows, and the pitch glides with each tempo step. Lock SMP on a step to another loop: it is in time too, from its own length.
For a loop with a tail or a gap, hold FUNC and turn FIN until it sits in time; that sample keeps its correction. Save the project to keep it.

access.location: SAMPLE page of any sound track.
steps: Press SMPL to open the SAMPLE page.
Hold FUNC and turn TUN to choose OFF, AUTO or 1/2/4/8 BAR.
Hold FUNC and turn FIN to correct the source tempo in percent.

controls.name: MODE
controls.doc: OFF, AUTO, 1 BAR, 2 BAR, 4 BAR or 8 BAR. FUNC + TUN on the SAMPLE page. Kept in the sound.

controls.name: AJUST
controls.doc: Correction of the source tempo of the sample the selected track plays, -12.7 to +12.7 % in 0.1 % steps, sample slots 1-123. FUNC + FIN on the SAMPLE page. Kept per sample slot with the project.

limitations: The shift is clamped to TUN's +-24 semitones and skipped beyond a factor of 8.
The silence check sees only digital silence under 5 % of a sample; other mis-cut loops need the per-sample correction.
Hooks the audio interrupt one instruction after rytm2_mods lfo-rnd's site; the pair is not tested.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.

hardware.summary: Build LS17 (core-ar2 0.3 + loop-sync 0.2.0-experimental) flashed with Elektron Transfer over USB on the author's unit, after LS16 on 24 October 2026. Loops follow the project tempo in AUTO, with SMP parameter locks, the per-sample percentage correction and the trailing-silence check; the pitch now glides when the tempo changes ("ça glisse bien maintenant").
limitations: Informal listening test; no timing measured on the unit.
Persistence of the mode across kit save and reboot, and of the corrections across project save and reboot, not reported.
Scenes that change SMP not reported separately for LS16.
No CPU or memory measurement on the unit.

tests.summary: Author tested LS17 on an Analog Rytm MKII (OS 1.74): loops in time with SMP locks, per-sample correction and trailing-silence check; the pitch glides on tempo changes. Emulator audio measurements in TESTING.md.
